name: DomainRacer
tagline: Budget Indian cPanel hosting with LiteSpeed servers and NVMe SSD storage
description: DomainRacer is a budget Indian web host offering cPanel shared, reseller, VPS and cloud hosting on LiteSpeed servers with NVMe SSD storage and 30-day refunds.
about: DomainRacer is an India-based web hosting provider built around standard cPanel for shared and reseller plans, with Plesk also offered on Windows plans. Its shared hosting lineup has four tiers — Basic, Personal, Silver and Advanced — running on LiteSpeed web servers with NVMe SSD storage, and it also sells reseller, VPS and cloud hosting.

The entry Basic plan starts near ₹58/month (roughly $0.99/month equivalent pricing DomainRacer advertises internationally) for 1GB of storage, 5GB bandwidth and a single website. The Personal, Silver and Advanced tiers step up to unlimited NVMe SSD storage and bandwidth, with website limits of 1, 3 and unlimited respectively; only the Advanced tier bundles a free domain. All tiers include a free SSL certificate, the Softaculous 1-click installer, the SitePad site builder and JetBackup.

Renewal pricing is meaningfully higher than the introductory rate — the Basic plan's advertised ₹58/month intro renews near ₹82/month, and the Advanced plan's ₹238.2/month intro renews near ₹288/month, both on a 1-year term. Longer prepaid terms (biennial, triennial) unlock deeper discounts on the intro rate, but the same renewal jump applies once that term ends, so it's worth budgeting for the renewal price rather than the headline discount.
policies: DomainRacer backs its hosting plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee, giving new customers a window to request a refund if the service doesn't work out.

Refund eligibility can exclude domain registration fees, licenses and other add-ons purchased alongside a hosting plan — check DomainRacer's own terms of service for the exact exclusions before buying.
